summary: Hanover Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing a new share repurchase program approved by its board on August 26, 2026. The program authorizes repurchase of up to 370,000 shares, approximately 5% of outstanding common stock, expiring August 17, 2027. Repurchases may occur in the open market or privately negotiated transactions, potentially under a Rule 10b5-1 plan. No specific price, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The program is discretionary, and management retains flexibility based on market conditions and regulatory requirements. Watch for execution pace and potential suspension as capital and liquidity needs evolve.
